concerns.text: FR-001 mandates downloading the 'Materials Project bulk dataset' from a URL that the upstream 'Verified datasets' block (and the kickback comments) explicitly identifies as unavailable or blocked. The spec requires a data source that does not exist in the verified context, making the research question unanswerable as written. The spec must either (a) switch to a verified numeric dataset (e.g., OQMD via a verified URL) or (b) redefine the research question to match available text-only data.

User Story 1 assumes the existence of a 'cleaned dataset of [deferred] inorganic compounds' with 'compositional and structural features'. The kickback comments confirm that the available 'MixSub' dataset is text-only and lacks the required numeric target variables (formation energy, bulk modulus). The spec fails to address this critical feasibility gap, effectively planning a pipeline that cannot execute.

User Story 3 requires a 'downstream screening case study' comparing selection precision. This requires ground-truth numeric values to calculate precision/recall. Since the spec relies on a blocked/unavailable numeric dataset (as per kickback comments), the screening task is mathematically undefined. The spec must resolve the data source blocker before defining downstream evaluation logic.

FR-005 mandates implementing a Sparse Gaussian Process with 500 inducing points and PCA. While methodologically sound, this requirement is contingent on the existence of the numeric feature matrix described in FR-001. Without a verified data source, this requirement is unbacked by any executable plan element, creating a logical deadlock.

SC-004 requires measuring the Coefficient of Variation (CV) of ECE scores across 3 seeds. This metric is impossible to calculate if the pipeline cannot run due to missing data. The spec must explicitly link this success criterion to a resolved data source or mark it as contingent on data availability.

The 'Assumptions' section assumes the Materials Project bulk download URL remains accessible. However, the kickback comments explicitly state this source is 'BLOCKED' or unavailable in the verified context. This assumption is factually incorrect based on the project's current constraints and must be corrected to reflect the actual data availability status.
